notes.title: The new Adventure starts NOW!
notes.content:
Hey future Beasties trainer!

Today is the day!
[b]Our first [b][url=https://bit.ly/3b9ooKS]Kickstarter[/url][/b] starts right NOW![/b]
[b]Support us on Kickstarter and be part of the development of Beasties from the very beginning![/b]

[previewyoutube=c3S9-u4dbu8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]About Beasties:[/b][/h3]
Beasties is a lovingly hand-drawn 2D top/down monster trainer game with a turn-based match-3 combat mechanic, where you take on the role of a Beastie trainer. Form alliances with Beasties, earn money with farming, explore the world, craft food for the Beasties and craft various items. Collect and manage resources, discover small and big secrets and solve countless side tasks and challenges in a peaceful (wholesome) and humorous world.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592600/Beasties__an_adorable_Monster_Trainer_Match3__Farming_game/

[h3][b]Key Features:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Sophisticated genre mix of Monster Trainer, Match-3 & Farming 
[*] Easy to learn, hard to master Turn-Based Match-3 Combat
[*]  Team up with Beasties, upgrade and customize them to your gameplay
[*] Earn money with farming
[*] Sell your goods or craft new ones on the market
[*]  Be a co-producer 🚀 and part of the development of this game
[*]  The game is 100% Plant-Based 🌾🌱 and we care about diversity 👧👳🏼‍♂️👴🏽👩🏾‍🦰
[*] The game will be released on PC (Steam, Gog etc) and on Nintendo Switch.
[/list]

notes.title: New Adventure ahead!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=H_pcu2vQNHc;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey Adventurer,

We at rokaplay have committed ourselves to the [url=https://www.rokaplay.com/mission-statement][b]mission[/b][/url] to develop wholesome games and therefore it's time to pack your backpack and set off on a new adventure!

🎉We present a heart project directly from the deep mines of the rokaplay team coming to Kickstarter!🎉

[url=https://bit.ly/3b9ooKS][b]Kickstarter[/b][/url] will start rolling on May the 18th and you are invited to join this special event, follow us into this new adventure!

If you love wholesome games as much as we do, follow us on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592600/Beasties__an_adorable_Monster_Trainer_Match3__Farming_game/][b]Steam[/b][/url]  or on [url=https://discord.gg/rokaplay][b]Discord[/b][/url] to never miss another adventure with us.

[url=https://linktr.ee/rokaplay][b]Follow us on Social Media[/b][/url]
Cheers and stay safe! 
Your team at rokaplay

notes.title: Discover the secrets of The Forgotten Land on june 25!
notes.content:
[i][h1]A clue leads you on a journey to a mysterious place..[/h1][/i]

[h1]The Forgotten Land will be released on June 25![/h1]

The Forgotten Land is an exciting turn-based "Combat & Puzzle Match 3" with streamlined RPG and Management elements in a dark fantasy setting. Set up a sheltering camp, improve your heroes' abilities and unlock tactical bonuses.

[b]Show your combat skills! [/b]
In turn-based battles you have to outwit your opponents' tactics, thwart their chances for counterattacks and cleverly use the special powers of your team.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8539254/9c9fcab605dd4803b5c7628b048389e951a4b460.png[/img]


[b]Level up to new strenghts! [/b]
Grow along your journey.
Develop your team and improve your heroes' individual abilities!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8539254/dee3e54f4d34c3bd79801310b84c242b4484bb5d.png[/img]


[h1]Wishlist the Forgotten Land now![/h1]
And get notified when you can start your journey!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1099460/


[h1]Real treasures awaits for the lucky ones[/h1]
Follow our rokaplay Steam page and join our Discord channel to get notified about a special competition starting next week!

notes.title: Stranded Sails – Shovel & Spyglass replace Master Sword & Shield
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025590/087d82e7de9d06f29e86c3a1c3b9396948cae2d4.jpg[/img]

Unique mix of adventure gameplay in the vein of Legend of Zelda and Stardew Valley-esque farming simulation

https://store.steampowered.com/app/943260

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Unique mix of adventure and farming simulator:[/b] Prove yourself as a dauntless adventurer and crafty farmer!
[*] [b]Exploration, crafting and farming:[/b] You will need better and better equipment and enough food for your journeys deep into the heart of the islands!
[*] [b]Story-driven quests: [/b]Quests tell the game's story and lead you from one adventure to the next!
[*] [b]Tricky puzzles and challenges:[/b] Fire up those tiny grey cells to solve the many exciting riddles!
[*] [b]Creation and expansion of a survivors' camp: [/b]Manage your provisional camp to survive!
[*] [b]Mysterious islands and dangers:[/b] Solve the secret of the cursed islands and fight against supernatural threats! 
[/list]

Take a first peek at the game with our Pre Alpha-Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MObtP-h4-Qg&t=

notes.title: Update - Hole in One on Hole 9 Now Possible!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

It came to our attention on the Community Hub that some people were getting stuck on getting Level 1 Hole 9 in 1 Shot. 

So this meant that it wasn't possible to get all achievements as one relies on getting under par. You should now be able to get all of the achievements!

Apologies for this bug and thanks for posting on the Community Hub!

notes.title: Misleading information - huge apologies!
notes.content:
Dear 3D Mini Golf fans. Huge apologies on our end as indeed there was some misleading information on the store page. We have now made the following changes:

1) There are 54 holes and 3 courses , versus 50 courses that we initially communicated. Again apologies
2) We have made it clearer that the game is local multiplayer versus online multiplayer.

We will be working with our developers soon to fix any bugs.

Again, apologies for the stuff up....

Kind regards,
Luke
